answer: Someone as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The hollow counter is kept in jetty and anchor reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 2856 identities would post 4723 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
